title: Olavinlinna Castle

terrainReference.basis: Native datum is the standard viewer DEM sample100.6225m at the anchor; unmodified terrain controls the model foundations. Water level is approximate.

note: Retained compound envelope and native bridge-aligned frame control scale/orientation. Picture-led towers, terraces, roofs and canopy are approximate. Native preview water/shore mask is not proof of precise runtime shoreline fit. NativeX bisects the two undirected pontoon segment axes. This keeps both actual mapped segments inside the road guard while every model control retains its world bearing. No connected-approach height hints are claimed. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
